notes: Modules come from the general SOMMAIRE (p6-7). That sommaire only lists rubrics, so the texts are the 'Textes à lire et à expliquer'. Module 1's texts come from its own sommaire (p9). For modules 2, 3 and 5 they come from page headings and are INCOMPLETE: the titles of the texts on p60 (module 2), p111 and p117 (module 3) and p246 (module 5) were not extracted, so those texts are left out. Module 4 combines comic portraits with the integrated reading of Voltaire's Candide (lecture suivie; the full text is appended on pp. 323-359). The last item is the second whole-work reading, Défense d'entrer by Anne-Lyse Grobéty (p307). Complementary readings and the rubrics (lexique, image, langue, oral, écriture) are left out.
